stage: Current scanner/sniper market inputs and transient full-decision reevaluation
findings: Queued exploratory price snapshots could become actual gate, rank and model inputs. The final fresh Jupiter-price guard did not reevaluate these earlier signals

Ordinary price+liquidity collection could return before collecting five-minute activity and momentum. Exploratory negative caches could prevent a legacy queue candidate from reaching the common entry evaluator

Queued scores, lane decisions, proxy flags and auxiliary model inputs could survive into a new evaluation; canonical stale market aliases and an old dex_id could override fresh provider fields. Liquidity proxy flags could also be merged from a fallback whose liquidity was not selected
Paper liquidity proxy helpers treated observed zero as absence, and one helper converted an unknown route into verified true
Admission route/impact probes used 0.05 SOL rather than the configured exact 0.1 SOL paper purchase

Async social, risk, lane, capacity and provider work could outlive the original market receipt before a buy intent. Ordinary retry exhaustion or queue expiry could permanently blacklist a temporarily uncertain mint

implementation.discovery_only_queue: Queued payloads carry detached discovery/identity context and the guarded checked paper-policy snapshot, not reusable market values, scores, prior lanes, proxy decisions, labels or risk/model conclusions. The legacy queue dispatches identity directly into the common fresh evaluator
implementation.entry_collection: A dedicated cache-bypassing one-pass snapshot collects price, liquidity, market cap, daily volume, five-minute buys/sells/activity and momentum where available. It retains original per-field HTTP receipts, normal provider priority/cooldowns/budgets/timeouts, meaningful zero and optional absence. It does not retry the complete chain for optional gaps or attach a different-sized diagnostic impact quote
implementation.normalization: All market aliases consumed by subsequent normalizers are removed after receipt rejection. Rejected field receipts are detached and removed from the current sanitized snapshot, leaving original input/cache objects unchanged. Fresh venue metadata wins over queued canonical aliases. Liquidity's provider-derived flags move with the selected liquidity and its receipt, not an ignored fallback, and remain frozen in both market and model inputs
implementation.frozen_inputs: Immutable market values and original source/receipt identities are frozen before lane and model evaluation. Post-social, post-risk, pre-model and pre-buy checks reject expired or changed market inputs. The final model vector's available market columns must match these frozen decision values; no late price replacement bypass is permitted
implementation.temporary_wait: Missing fresh price/collection, quota waits and expired/changed observations clear pending vectors, emit a wait rather than a negative target, and requeue the entire decision after five seconds. These waits preserve retry budget regardless of customized environment prefixes. Existing absolute queue age/capacity remain bounded, but expiring a receipt wait does not permanently blacklist that mint
implementation.paper_proxy: Only explicitly generated paper estimates can fill unknown liquidity. They carry a separate configured-proxy basis, kind, value and generation time, never HTTP liquidity proof. Observed zero is not replaced. Route-backed proxies require route true, not unknown; live cannot consume the paper-proxy observation contract
implementation.exact_probe: Entry route/impact probes use the configured exact paper amount, currently 0.1 SOL; other profiles use their configured base amount. Invalid/nonfinite/bool amounts or impacts are not accepted. Actual order/fill guards remain separate
implementation.final_jupiter_evidence: The separate final Jupiter-price admission guard no longer overwrites the already-evaluated source/price-confidence metadata. It remains independent evidence, not a replacement for earlier decision inputs
implementation.extreme_upside: No new return, observed-peak, momentum or take-profit ceiling was introduced. New synthetic market-vector tests retain momentum values through +1000000 percent; earlier runner tests retain uncapped extreme peaks with duration/drawdown/liquidity protection. These are software checks, not earned returns

source_sync.later_copy_scope: Reviewed source and evidence paths only, with absolute workspace containment checks; publishing changes are exclusively this stage

verification.scope: Synthetic provider replies, direct current-snapshot and feature-builder execution, original AST-extracted production entry prefix/pre-buy/defer/proxy/probe-amount/queue-consumer branches, real queue retry/expiry/capacity rules, detached provenance and missing/zero/extreme observations. No runtime provider request, new trading run, model training or active model/policy write

limitations_and_next_work: Client HTTP receipt age does not establish provider market-as-of time, truthful pool depth, on-chain freshness or executable fill profitability
This stage validates and freezes market inputs, not every auxiliary social/rug/cluster provider's age contract or every lane-dependent model inference recomputation
Current candidate receipts are checked during evaluation; durable full-strategy prospective provenance and all research/export failure paths remain separate acceptance work
Live wallet/raw quantity/finality reconciliation, production response contracts, full-strategy capital/admission/execution constraints and first-launch evidence remain to be completed

Extreme-runner targets and uncapped upside do not guarantee opportunities will be found, bought profitably or sold profitably. Costed prospective full-strategy closed evidence remains necessary before any financial claim
